tools.name: create_doc
tools.description: Create a document and return its public URL. Re-using an existing name adds a new immutable version. Omit the name to get a random one. For content larger than ~10KB or any file already on disk, do NOT inline it here - run `docbin push <file> [--name <doc>]` in your shell instead (set DOCBIN_TOKEN t

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Fetch the raw stored content of a document. Defaults to your own handle and the latest version.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search your documents by name. Returns matches with their URLs and latest versions.
